'''Drage''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|ethics officer]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed at [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] as an ethics officer when an individual told him about the "minefield game".<ref name="TOR" />
